tickerText: [TENNIS] Rolex Paris Masters Day 4 Tuesday puts Djokovic–Vacherot and wild card Kouame on Court Central before Shelton–Norrie and Ruud–Jodar close the night session • [SQUASH] PSA Platinum U.S. Open round-of-16 Day 2 runs Tuesday evening in Philadelphia on two glass courts as top seeds Amina Orfi and Mostafa Asal push toward the quarters • [BADMINTON] Yeosu Victor Korea Open Super 500 opens with qualifying at Jinnam Stadium as home No. 1 An Se Young chases a record-equalling 11th title of 2026 • [PICKLEBALL] Opendoor PPA Worlds main draw begins Tuesday at Brookhaven with Round of 64 play across five pro divisions after Monday qualifying • [TABLE TENNIS] WTT Champions Frankfurt 2026 opens at Süwag Energie Arena with the season's final Champions draw as Montpellier winners Sun Yingsha and Jang Woojin head to Germany

newsItems.title: Korea Open Begins
newsItems.excerpt: Qualifying starts at Jinnam Stadium in Yeosu as An Se Young opens her home Super 500 campaign chasing an 11th title of the season.

newsItems.title: Worlds Round of 64
newsItems.excerpt: Brookhaven hosts the Opendoor PPA Worlds main draw Tuesday with first-serve at 11 a.m. CT across singles, doubles and mixed after Monday qualifying.

newsItems.title: Paris Day 4
newsItems.excerpt: Djokovic meets Vacherot and Ruud faces Rafael Jodar on Court Central Tuesday after Monday first-round wins from Musetti, Ruud and Norrie.

newsItems.title: U.S. Open Last 16
newsItems.excerpt: Philadelphia's PSA Platinum U.S. Open continues with round-of-16 Day 2 on two courts Tuesday evening at the Arlen Specter Center.
